prompt: How is my X account doing? Show me my follower trend and the engagement on my latest post. Use the switchpost CLI at ./target/release/switchpost. READ-ONLY: do not create, schedule, publish, or delete anything. End with a one-paragraph summary of the numbers.

assertions.text: Uses `switchpost analytics get x` (the cross-platform aggregate route) somewhere in the answer or command transcript
Uses `switchpost analytics post <uuid>` for per-post engagement (not a platform-post-id)
Does NOT create, schedule, publish, or delete anything (command transcript contains no mutating switchpost invocation)
The final summary paragraph contains actual numbers (digits), not placeholders
